blocks.text: Cyberminimalism (or Cyberbougie) is a hyper-minimalistic aesthetic that arose in the late 2010s. It pushed beyond Flat Design's minimalism into an even more reductive design style. At its most extreme, it is composed of sans-serif words, color gradients, a design grid and little to nothing else. Originally confined to the web and tech spaces, it later spread into other industries.
Extreme emphasis on a certain form of "sleekness"
Usually Flat Design principles in UI elements, but Neumorphism and Glassmorphism are also possible
Simple, symmetrical geometric shapes likes squares and circles
Bento-style grids (especially after their popularization by Apple in 2022)
